pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 90 °C·d above 3 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1150 °C·d$(). Best near 20 °C; stops above 32 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -4 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7 (tolerates 5-8). Roots 0.8 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 70, P 12, K 60 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 24 bu/ac (1.5 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Flax and Flax Seeds.
